data_sources: IDW uses previous-day visible depths only, power 2, at most 6 donors.
Fictional wells. NASA POWER weather forced the synthetic generator and is not a well gauge.
GCN-LSTM uses the frozen eight features and previous-day visible lags.
Each neural date is the last position of the window ending on that date.
